title: Field creation: a searchable type picker; Add field asks for label and type before creating
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `d4bc81eab`, 2026-10-15. "Add field" (the Form tab toolbar and the object header's ⋯ menu) creates a field at once named "New field" with api name `field_10` and type Text, then opens the field inspector; the designer renames and retypes it afterwards. The inspector's Type control (`metadata-admin/inspectors/FieldTypePicker.tsx`) is a listbox of 45 types in 8 groups (Text 10, Number 3, Date / time 3, Logic 2, Selection 4, Relation 4, Media 5, Calculated 3, Advanced 15), each with a one-line description, and no search box; reaching "Picklist" means scrolling past the Text, Number, Date and Logic groups.

## Target

1. The type listbox opens with a search input focused at the top; typing filters on the type's label, api value and description (`pick` leaves Picklist alone, `look` leaves Lookup); groups stay as headings over the matches.
2. "Add field" opens a small popover with Label (required; api name derived as the inspector does today) and Type (the same searchable picker, Text preselected) and a Create button; the field is created with those values and opens in the inspector as today.
3. The empty-form "Add field" and the Form toolbar's share the popover.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/FieldTypePicker.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the add-field handler), `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: typing `pick` shows Picklist only; the popover creates a field named as typed with the chosen type.
2. Screenshots of the picker with a query and of the popover, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- The 45 types and their groups do not change.
- Existing `data-testid`s stay.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-15 Studio test pass: objectui main `d4bc81eab`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, viewport 1482 × 1119, dark theme with a light-theme check.</sub>

## Evidence

Screenshots from the test pass, kept on the temporary branch `claude/studio-test-pass-evidence-20261015` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `72115588c`, never merged: the maintainer ruled that screenshots do not enter main, and asked for a temporary branch referenced from the card). The branch's `docs/design/studio-redesign/findings/2026-10-15/README.md` maps every file to its card. Pane captures, 800 × 604 of a 1482 × 1119 viewport, dark unless named light.
